pre_registration.name: venue_park_factor
pre_registration.status: pre-registered 2026-10-08, before any candidate below was fitted (2021-26 still sealed)
pre_registration.motivation: Loss autopsy (reports/loss_autopsy.md, reports/loss_autopsy_round2.md; 2011-21 only). Most losses are shooting and pace variance, but two pre-game ideas passed the screen rule (|t| >= 2 in 2011-18 and the same sign with |t| >= 1.5 in 2018-21) against the locked engine's own forecast: (1) a home floor's "park factor": floors whose earlier games ran over their closing totals keep doing so (t +5.50, +4.95 on all games; +3.40, +2.23 on the bets' own margins; about +0.5 points of total per point of factor in both eras); (2) high-altitude venues (t +3.48, +2.82), which keep about +1.7 points after the venue factor is controlled for. Ratings average a team's home and road games and the opener is set from team numbers, so venue-specific scoring is left over.
pre_registration.engine: locked v3 (config/stage3_v3_locked.yaml); only the mean model gets extra features; the variance model, calibrator, decays, eligibility and products are unchanged.

definitions.venue_factor: non-neutral game: the home team's earlier non-neutral home games, from the first day of the season three seasons back up to the day before the game, shrunk mean of (final total - closing total) = sum / (n + 40); clean games with a valid close only. Neutral-site games: 0. (scripts/loss_autopsy_round2.py venue_features, extended to every season.)
definitions.high_altitude: venue city (ESPN schedule) in the fixed 17-city list of scripts/loss_autopsy.py HIGH_ALT; unknown venue = 0

candidates.V2_venue_altitude: locked v3 mean features + venue_factor + high_altitude

pre_registration.selection_rule: as study_2: a candidate qualifies with lower log loss AND higher matched-volume ROI at -110 than the locked engine in BOTH eras; among qualifiers the higher pooled 2011-21 matched ROI is selected (V1 on a tie). If none qualifies, the study stops and 2021-26 stays sealed.
pre_registration.confirmation: as study_2: ONE run on the sealed 2021-22 .. 2025-26 seasons for the selected candidate only (the script refuses to run twice). Passes with lower log loss AND matched-volume ROI not lower at -110 and at the best book's real price. Pass = recorded next to the locked engine in the 2026-27 forward ledger; the forward season decides any switch.
pre_registration.secondary: bets with a strong venue factor (|factor| >= 1) that agrees or disagrees with the bet; 2.5+ cards and main-line doubles at real prices if the confirmation runs. Not part of the rule.
pre_registration.disclosure: Both ideas were found on 2011-21, the same seasons the selection rule uses, so the selection is optimistic; the 2021-26 run is the real test. 2021-26 was used before only with the locked engine (stage-2b test, stage-3 re-analysis, diagnostics, money pages, 2023-24 ledger); no venue, altitude or availability analysis has read it.
